Eight production methods reach `CircuitStateController.EnsureNotDisposed`, and one test file exercises them. The call graph (`devkb` pack for `EnsureNotDisposed`) and a grep of `src/Polly.Core/CircuitBreaker` agree on this.

**Calls `EnsureNotDisposed()` directly** (line numbers in `CircuitStateController.cs`):
- `CircuitStateController.CircuitState` (line 53, property getter)
- `CircuitStateController.LastException` (line 66, property getter)
- `CircuitStateController.LastHandledOutcome` (line 79, property getter)
- `CircuitStateController.IsolateCircuitAsync` (line 90)
- `CircuitStateController.CloseCircuitAsync` (line 110)
- `CircuitStateController.OnActionPreExecuteAsync` (line 126)
- `CircuitStateController.OnUnhandledOutcomeAsync` (line 196)
- `CircuitStateController.OnHandledOutcomeAsync` (line 222)

**Reaches it indirectly:**
- `CircuitBreakerResilienceStrategy.ExecuteCore` (in `src/Polly.Core/CircuitBreaker/CircuitBreakerResilienceStrategy.cs`) calls these three controller methods:
  - `OnActionPreExecuteAsync` (line 32)
  - `OnHandledOutcomeAsync` (line 52)
  - `OnUnhandledOutcomeAsync` (line 56)
- The `CircuitBreakerResilienceStrategy` constructor (lines 18–21) hands `_controller.CircuitState`, `IsolateCircuitAsync` and `CloseCircuitAsync` to the state provider and manual control. It doesn't call them itself, so the constructor isn't a caller. Those paths are reached only when the provider or manual control invokes them.

**Depth limit:** `ExecuteCore` is an override, so it is called through virtual dispatch. The graph can't attribute those callers to a specific method. It flagged 9 unresolved call sites in `src/Polly.Core/Utils/Pipeline/` (`DelegatingComponent.cs`, `BridgeComponent.cs`, `BridgeComponent.TResult.cs`, `CompositeComponent.cs`). It also flagged `test/Polly.Core.Tests/Hedging/HedgingResilienceStrategyTests.cs` and `bench/Polly.Core.Benchmarks/CompositeComponentBenchmark.cs`. 40 symbols share the name `ExecuteCore`, so most of these are probably calls to other strategies' methods. I did not trace them. Any `ResiliencePipeline` that contains a circuit breaker strategy would reach the controller through those pipeline components.

**Test file:**
- `test/Polly.Core.Tests/CircuitBreaker/Controller/CircuitStateControllerTests.cs`

  The graph also lists 34 more tests in this file. For example, line 167 asserts that `IsolateCircuitAsync` throws `ObjectDisposedException`. It is the only test file the graph linked to this path. I did not search for tests of `CircuitBreakerResilienceStrategy` or the pipeline.
